claim: Two of the three DICOM attribute names this study measures have never appeared in the Europe PMC corpus at all, and no publication reports a population or rate over any of them.
value: SegmentationAlgorithmIdentificationSequence 0 hits; ContributingEquipmentSequence 0 hits; SegmentAlgorithmName 2 hits; union 2 hits. Crossed with census 0, audit 0, population 1, rate 2. Both hits identified and neither reports a population statistic: PMID 41113334, AI Model Passport, Comput Struct Biotechnol J 2025, doi 10.1016/j.csbj.2025.09.041; and PMID 39443503, Murugesan et al, Sci Data 2024, doi 10.1038/s41597-024-03977-8
floor: not applicable, this row reports a literature search rather than a validator rate
dropped: nothing; every hit returned is identified by PMID and DOI
command: curl the Europe PMC REST search endpoint, https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=<term>&format=json
status_note: This is the most auditable negative supporting the lead finding: a reader can re-run three exact queries against a public API and get an integer. It was flagged as not executed in addendum 03 section 5 item 3 and is now executed. It bounds the literature and not the practice: a zero hit count says the attribute name does not appear in indexed text, not that nobody has ever measured it.
notes: Murugesan 2024 is the counterexample the discussion cites, because producers there do route identity into SegmentAlgorithmName.

claim: No DICOM Correction Proposal in the complete numbered series promotes SegmentationAlgorithmIdentificationSequence (0062,0007) from Type 3 to conditional, or otherwise requires algorithm provenance in the Segmentation IOD.
value: 2,648 Correction Proposals parsed, CP-1 to CP-2649, the complete numbered series. 78 carry a title matching segmentation, algorithm, provenance or equipment. None promotes a provenance attribute to conditional. The nearest prior actions on this table left the Type unchanged: CP-1597 Clarify Segmentation Algorithm Parameters (2016d), CP-1258 Refactor segment description (2011), and CP-2115 Per-segment multiple algorithms and creators (2021d). The counter-current is confirmed: CP-2428 Add Algorithm Identification to RT Dose Module (2025c) and CP-2320 Communication that data is synthetic (2024a) both add provenance at Type 3.
floor: not applicable, this row reports a documentary search
dropped: title screening only; CP bodies were not read, so a CP whose title does not name segmentation, algorithm, provenance or equipment but whose body touches (0062,0007) would be missed
command: curl https://www.dclunie.com/dicom-status/status.html and parse the Correction Proposals by Number table
external_source: dclunie.com/dicom-status/status.html, Correction Proposals by Number, retrieved 2026-08-02
status_note: Addendum 03 section 4 recorded this negative as solid for roughly 2023 to 2026 and UNVERIFIED before 2023, because the CP-by-number table had truncated in fetch. The full table parses here, CP-1 to CP-2649, so the negative no longer needs scoping to a window. What it is still scoped to is title screening.
notes: CP-2273, Clarify whether zero length Type 3 Sequences are allowed or not, is confirmed in this table at Standard, edition 2026b.
